title: Flags of the Americas Quiz: 20 Flags
description: Identify 20 flags from Latin America and the Caribbean, from Chile and Peru to Jamaica and the Bahamas, in this free flags quiz.
h1: Flags of the Americas Quiz: Can You Name Them?
intro: From the stars of Chile to the golden cross of Jamaica, the flags of the Americas are bold, colorful and sometimes hard to tell apart. This quiz shows you 20 national flags from South America, Central America and the Caribbean. You will start with flags you probably know, like Chile, Peru and Cuba, then tackle tricky look-alikes such as Costa Rica and Panama or Guatemala and Honduras, and finish with the Bahamas, Trinidad and Tobago and Belize. You have about five seconds for each, so trust your eyes. A short explanation follows each answer. Ready to test your sharp eye?

faq: Why do some flags in the Americas look so similar?

Many Latin American countries were part of the same empires or federations, and they borrowed colors and patterns from each other. For example, Colombia, Ecuador and Venezuela all descend from the flag of Gran Colombia and share its yellow, blue and red.
Which countries in the Americas does the quiz cover?

The quiz covers countries in South America, Central America and the Caribbean. The United States, Canada and Mexico are featured in our world flags quiz. Here you will find flags such as those of Chile, Cuba, Jamaica, Uruguay and Belize.
Which flag in the Americas is unusual?

Paraguay's flag has a different emblem on each side, which is very rare. Belize's flag shows two people in its coat of arms. Haiti's and Dominican Republic's flags include coats of arms, and the Dominican Republic's features an open Bible.
